payload.text: BioSurplus – Buy, Sell and Auction Used Life Sciences Equipment Close Search BioSurplus is Back! The trusted life sciences equipment marketplace returns with a renewed focus on helping labs, biotech companies, pharmaceutical manufacturers and research institutions buy, sell and auction quality pre-owned equipment. BioSurplus connects buyers and sellers of laboratory and life sciences assets through direct purchase listings, curated auction events and equipment selling solutions designed to maximize value. Buy Pre-Owned Equipment Explore quality pre-owned instruments from trusted sellers. Browse Inventory → Sell Surplus Equipment Turn surplus assets into value with our flexible selling solutions. Sell Equipment → Life Sciences Auctions Bid with confidence in our curated online auction events. Coming Soon! The Next Move for Science Our Mission Giving life-science equipment a smarter next life, creating value for sellers, opportunity for buyers, and momentum for science. Our Vision A future where every life-science asset has the opportunity to create value again. ” We believe surplus is rarely the end of the story. Behind every idle asset is a company moving in a new direction and an opportunity to create value elsewhere. BioSurplus helps life-science companies move forward by giving every asset a smarter path to what comes next. Values Create Value on Both Sides Value can mean recovering capital from equipment you no longer need, accessing quality equipment at the right price, avoiding unnecessary spend, saving time, or keeping valuable resources in motion. We work to create better outcomes for both sides of every opportunity. Understand Before We Act We start by listening. Whether you’re looking for equipment or deciding what to do with the equipment you have, the right solution begins with understanding your goals, timeline, and needs. Choose The Right Next Move Buy. Sell. Source. Redeploy. Auction. There is no one-size-fits-all solution. We help identify the path that makes the most sense for each asset, buyer, and seller. Know Science. Understand the Business Equipment decisions are connected to bigger business goals. We understand the instruments, research needs, budgets, growth plans, and transitions behind every equipment decision, and use that knowledge to help our customers move forward with confidence. Own the Relationship Clients should always know who is accountable, what is happening, and what comes next.
